newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sri Lanka rebels say two leaders slain in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rebels say two leaders slain in Paris.

text.p: Rebel Sri Lankan Tamils said on Sunday two of the group's officials had been shot dead in Paris on Saturday night and blamed the killings on the Colombo government.

"The LTTE (Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam) condemns the killing of Mr Kandiah Perinpanatham, head of the finance section of the LTTE International secretariat and the editor of the Tamil weekly newspaper Eela Murasu Mr Kandiah Gajendram," an LTTE statement received in Paris said.

LTTE said the two activists were shot in the La Chapelle district of northern Paris. A spokesman for Paris police confirmed that two unidentified Sri Lanka nationals had been shot dead overnight at La Chapelle, a heavily immigrant district.

"This dastardly act is considered by our organisation as part of the Sri Lankan government's international conspiracy to destroy the legitimate struggle of the Tamil people for freedom and peace by curbing the financial assistance provided by Tamil people all over the world," the LTTE statement said.
The Tamil Tiger rebels are fighting a bloody war against Sri Lankan troops for an independent Tamil homeland in the island's north and east.
